facts: Parties: Vantage Pharma plc (Buyer), Ivybridge Robotics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Holloway Media Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 31 December 2025; Closing is scheduled for 25 February 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $10,000,000.

Section 9.5 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $11,250,000. The Purchase Price is $90,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $4,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,000,000.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Corrib Media Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $450,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
